summary.text: Jason Barr is the Democratic candidate for the West Virginia House of Delegates, District 16, in the November 3, 2026 general election, after advancing from the May 12, 2026 primary.
A construction worker and U.S. Marine Corps Reserve veteran, he describes himself in a Ballotpedia survey as pro-labor and pro-public education.

paragraphs.text: Barr graduated from Ripley High School and served in the U.S. Marine Corps Reserve from 1992 to 2003.
He earned associate degrees from WVU Parkersburg in 1994 and 2023, and his career experience includes working in construction.
Barr previously ran in the 2016 Democratic primary for West Virginia House of Delegates District 12, which Missy Morris won.

In a Ballotpedia survey for 2026, he listed repealing what he called "right to work," reinstating prevailing wage for publicly funded construction projects, funding and protecting public education, and preventing privatization of government services among his policy priorities.
